findings.title: The coherence workflow still signs v2 statements as the v1 predicate type
findings.specimen: templates/workflows/attavo-coherence.yml (unchanged by 6c1ddbd; lines 40 and 118 still use https://attavo.dev/attestation/v1), while schema/attestation.schema.json declares https://attavo.dev/attestation/v2
findings.retires: The build’s implicit claim that changing the schema $id alone completes the attestation-v2 migration; it also closes the stale v1 predicate-type contract preserved by test_predicate_type_is_the_ruled_url.
findings.rejection_test: tests/test_coherence_template.py::test_predicate_type_matches_attestation_schema_id — load schema/attestation.schema.json, read its $id, and assert the workflow’s predicate-type equals it (replacing the current test that explicitly requires /v1).
findings.severity: Blocking when a schema-v2 attestation reaches the merge_group signing step: it is published under the v1 predicate type; harmless only while no v2 statement is signed through that workflow.
